description: Set the app's privacy policy URL, using Play Console's own web session. Mandatory App content declaration, and a prerequisite for submitting the Data safety declaration.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

privacy_policy_url.description: A real, publicly accessible URL (http:// or https://) to the app's privacy policy page.

name: update_privacy_policy
